Here's a warm introduction email you can send:

:::writing{variant="email" id="58341" subject="Introduction: Casey & DJ"}
DJ,

I wanted to make an introduction to Casey. I think there may be an opportunity for the two of you to help each other.

Casey owns and operates a growing aesthetic practice and is currently looking for both an experienced injector and a strong front desk/patient concierge team member to support her growth. Knowing the work Scrub Ops does and the network you've built within the industry, I immediately thought of you.

Casey, DJ is the founder of Scrub Ops and has become a fantastic resource for practices looking to find quality talent and operational support within the aesthetics space. He understands the unique challenges of hiring in our industry and may be a great person to connect with as you continue building your team.

I'll let you two take it from here, but I had a feeling this could be a valuable conversation for both sides.

Looking forward to seeing what comes of it.

Best,

Bethany Gifford  
Co-Founder & CEO | The Luxora Collective  
Growth Partners for Med Spa Owners Ready to Scale  
bethany@theluxoracollective.co
:::

If Casey is the owner of a specific practice, I can make it more personal by mentioning her practice name, location, and what type of injector/front desk role she's trying to fill.
write Dj and connect him with Casey, she needs a new injector and a new front desk.
